rules.trigger_description: For demo: two or more of sleep ≥1.5 h below baseline, resting HR ≥10 bpm above baseline, fatigue ≥7/10 across recent observations.
rules.explanation: Multiple fatigue-related indicators have shifted from your usual pattern.
rules.suggested_action: Complete fatigue check-in; review schedule and findings with crew medical officer.
rules.limitation: Do not label sleep deprivation syndrome or prescribe sleep medication.

rules.trigger_description: For demo: mood worsens ≥3 points relative to baseline and high stress persists across 2 check-ins.
rules.explanation: Your recent mood and stress check-ins show a change worth reviewing.
rules.suggested_action: Offer private check-in, optional support resources and crew medical review.
rules.limitation: Do not diagnose depression or automatically share private notes.

rules.trigger_description: For demo: 2 planned countermeasure sessions missed in 3 days.
rules.explanation: Planned exercise sessions were not recorded as completed.
rules.suggested_action: Verify log accuracy and review the individualized exercise plan with crew health staff.
rules.limitation: Missed workouts do not quantify bone or muscle loss.

rules.trigger_description: Simulated dose-rate crosses a configurable mission exercise threshold.
rules.explanation: The simulated radiation monitor reports an elevated dose rate.
rules.suggested_action: Confirm sensor status; notify crew lead and consult approved radiation procedure.
rules.limitation: Do not claim a universal NASA dose limit.

rules.trigger_description: Simulated solar particle event flag from mission environmental system.
rules.explanation: A simulated high-radiation event has been reported.
rules.suggested_action: Activate mission-approved radiation response protocol and crew notification.
rules.limitation: No improvised shielding or medical instructions.

rules.trigger_description: Simulated critical cabin-environment flag from a trusted environmental sensor.
rules.explanation: A simulated critical cabin condition requires immediate crew attention.
rules.suggested_action: Open approved spacecraft emergency checklist and alert crew lead.
rules.limitation: No universal pressure/O2 emergency threshold is asserted.

rules.trigger_description: New vision-change symptom reported on self-check.
rules.explanation: You reported a change in vision. A questionnaire cannot determine its cause.
rules.suggested_action: Request crew medical evaluation using mission-approved eye assessment process.
rules.limitation: Do not diagnose SANS or infer intracranial pressure.

rules.trigger_description: Required sensor missing, stale, implausible, or insufficient baseline.
rules.explanation: There is not enough reliable information to assess this indicator.
rules.suggested_action: Verify sensor and enter or obtain a new measurement.
rules.limitation: Never interpret missing readings as normal.
